en.title: Separating motion from the scene.
en.description: Background modeling provides foreground observations for downstream perception. Toggle the overlay to compare a synthetic point cloud with its foreground view.
en.quality: How reliable is the distinction between background and moving objects?
en.heading: Background modeling
en.summary: Separate moving objects from the static scene

en.title: From points to traffic participants.
en.description: Detection organizes foreground points into object hypotheses. This illustration adds colored groups and bounding boxes to the same synthetic road scene.
en.quality: How does uneven point coverage affect an object’s representation?
en.heading: 3D detection
en.summary: Organize foreground points into traffic participants

en.title: Maintaining identity over time.
en.description: Tracking connects observations across frames. The trails and labels show the idea of continuous vehicle trajectories rather than outputs from the tracking algorithm.
en.quality: Can identity and trajectory continuity survive sparse observations and occlusion?
en.heading: Multi-object tracking

en.title: Interpreting interactions with care.
en.description: Trajectory-based safety analysis depends on the observations behind it. The bands illustrate positional uncertainty around two crossing paths; no TTC, PET, or risk score is computed here.
en.quality: How could trajectory uncertainty change the interpretation of a close interaction?
en.heading: Conflict analysis
en.summary: Use trajectories to study interactions and risk

zh.title: 从场景中分离运动目标。
zh.description: 背景建模为下游感知提供前景观测。切换显示选项，比较合成点云与前景分离示意。
zh.quality: 背景与运动目标的区分有多可靠？
zh.heading: 背景建模
zh.summary: 从静态场景中分离运动目标

zh.title: 从点云到交通参与者。
zh.description: 目标检测将前景点组织为目标假设。这里在同一合成道路场景中展示彩色点组与目标边界框。
zh.quality: 点云覆盖不均匀会如何影响目标表征？
zh.overlay: 显示目标分组与边界框
zh.heading: 三维检测
zh.summary: 将前景点组织为交通参与者

zh.title: 在时间中保持目标身份。
zh.description: 跟踪连接不同帧中的观测。轨迹线与身份标签用于说明连续车辆轨迹的概念，并非跟踪算法的实际输出。
zh.quality: 观测稀疏或遮挡时，目标身份和轨迹能否保持连续？
zh.heading: 多目标跟踪
zh.summary: 跨帧关联，形成连续轨迹

zh.title: 审慎理解交通交互。
zh.description: 基于轨迹的安全分析依赖其背后的观测质量。色带表示两条交叉路径周围的位置不确定性；这里不计算 TTC、PET 或风险分数。
zh.quality: 轨迹不确定性可能如何改变对近距离交互的判断？
zh.heading: 冲突分析
zh.summary: 利用轨迹研究车辆交互与风险
